_comment: Template for Beauty Products Data Quality Reports
_description: This template defines the structure of quality reports generated by the ETL pipeline. Reports are written to s3://very-great-products-processed-us-east-1-poc/quality-reports/beauty-products/YYYY/MM/DD/

quality_issues._comment: Key-value pairs of issue type and count

_usage_instructions.query_example: SELECT * FROM beauty_products_metadata_db.data_quality_metrics WHERE avg_quality_score < 0.90 ORDER BY execution_timestamp DESC
_usage_instructions.bi_tool: Import JSON files into QuickSight for dashboard visualization
_usage_instructions.alerting: CloudWatch alarm triggers if pass_rate < 0.90 for consecutive runs

_field_definitions.job_run_id: Unique identifier for the ETL job run (format: jr_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
_field_definitions.execution_timestamp: When the job was executed in UTC (ISO 8601 format)
_field_definitions.source_file: S3 path to the source CSV file processed
_field_definitions.total_records: Total number of records read from source CSV
_field_definitions.records_warned: Records with quality score 0.70-0.95 (acceptable but flagged)
_field_definitions.records_failed: Records with quality score < 0.70 (sent to quarantine)
_field_definitions.records_duplicates: Number of duplicate records removed during deduplication
_field_definitions.records_anomalies: Records flagged as anomalies (revenue > $10M or items > 1M)
_field_definitions.pass_rate: Percentage of records that passed quality checks (0.0-1.0)
_field_definitions.quality_issues: Object containing counts of each quality issue type
_field_definitions.avg_quality_score: Average quality score across all processed records (0.0-1.0)
_field_definitions.min_quality_score: Minimum quality score observed in this job run
_field_definitions.max_quality_score: Maximum quality score observed (should be 1.0 if any perfect records)
_field_definitions.transformation_version: Version of the ETL transformation logic applied (semantic versioning)
